items.title: Art Deco Fluid Wave Screen Design for High-Privacy CNC Cutting
items.description: A dense, high-coverage Art Deco cutting template featuring a fluid repeating pattern of stylized waves and majestic feathers. Available for instant download in DXF, SVG, and DWG vectors, this file is engineered specifically for projects requiring maximum privacy without sacrificing airflow and aesthetic depth. Ideal for fabricating outdoor balcony railings, commercial space dividers, and protective architectural window screens.
